notes: The chicken jockey's 5%/5% rolls are stubs in the shared egg path (hostiles.c:113-122: the draws run, the chicken select/spawn is commented as unported). fight-zombie-s1 records the melee fight; mobspawn-final-s1 the spawn tables including armor and leader rolls. lane/idxentity: the HARD reinforcement (a real play path: the options screen sets HARD) was missing; ent-reinforce-s1 punches three zombies on HARD at night, one roll passes and the reinforcement spawns on the platform. ent-kill-s1 covers the sun-damaged helmet breaking (renderBrokenItemStack's draws) and a pumpkin helmet (not damageable: no draw). lane/reloadstate: readEntityFromNBT's ConversionTime > -1 runs startConversion on a load (snapshot_entities.c restore_living_nbt), and canDespawn is !isConverting (living.c living_can_despawn); cure-reload-s1 failed on master.
